title: "THE FIRST PORTFOLIO"
paragraph_01: The First Portfolio I created, started around the time I coined the idea originally during my time at Folk high school
paragraph_02: However it would take me until I was at the NAV connected guidance company named "Funkweb" that I would take the initiative to build myself a portfolio site that would showcase the work I had done so far, which at the time wasn't particularly much
paragraph_03:
The site graphics consisted of looking a lot like the map I was developing at the time, with a lot of yellow and stripes to match the look. While the site itself consisted of 5 tabs
  • The Intro
  • Game Development
  • Blender
  • Video Editing
  • Graphical Work
paragraph_04: The site was designed to get as much info as possible for any potential people with interests, which in one sense however bloated the site too much. Behind the graphics, there was a huge line of code that I spent over two weeks coding by hand back in 2023
paragraph_05: The Portfolio did help me several times to gain a job or close to one, one notable time being when I was in two interviews with Snowcastle Games
paragraph_06: Though after creating it, I never really updated it afterwards because I felt like I didn't have enough yet to showcase. It was only in 2026 when I then again made a new Portfolio
